Population.evidence_source: our inclusion criteria (see Table 1) aimed to recruit a small number of participants with a shared relationship to both suicidality and psychosis.
Population.warning: The term 'suicidality' is too broad to map to the specific Population categories (Attempted Suicide, Suicidal Ideation, Bereaved) without further detail on the nature of the experience or the gender of the participants in the recruitment criteria.
